title: The Weekend Awaits
content:
Without wasting another second, Sneha spoke.

"Siddu... is that really you?"

There was a brief silence on the other end.

Then came a familiar voice, filled with surprise.

"Yes... this is Siddharth. Who's speaking?"

A smile spread across Sneha's face.

"It's me... Sneha."

For a moment, Siddu didn't say a word.

"Sneha?" he asked, almost unable to believe it. "Is this really you?"

"Yes," she replied with a soft laugh.

"I can't believe this," Siddu said. "How did you even get my number?"

"I'll tell you everything when we meet," Sneha replied playfully. "But first, answer my question."

"What question?"

"Why did you leave the train like that? You disappeared without even saying goodbye. You left your story unfinished... and left me with a thousand questions."

A sigh escaped from Siddu.

"I'm sorry, Sneha. Something important came up that day. I had no choice but to leave immediately."

"What was it?" she asked curiously.

There was another pause.

"I can't tell you right now," Siddu replied calmly. "One day you'll know everything... but not yet."

Although she was disappointed, Sneha could sense the seriousness in his voice.

"Alright," she said softly. "I won't force you."

To lighten the mood, she changed the topic.

"So... where are you now?"

"I live in Bengaluru," Siddu replied. "But I'm away from college at the moment."

Sneha's eyes lit up.

"Really? Then... would you be free this weekend?"

"I think so. Why?"

Sneha hesitated for a moment.

"There's still so much I want to ask you. Would you... like to meet?"

Siddu smiled.

"I'd like that. Where?"

"How about Shimla?"

Siddu smiled.

"Shimla it is."

"Sure. I'd like that."

A wave of happiness rushed through Sneha.

"Promise me one thing," she said.

"What is it?"

"When we meet, you'll continue your story from where you stopped."

A gentle laugh escaped from Siddu.

"I promise. This time, I won't leave the story unfinished."

Both of them smiled.

After exchanging a few more words, they ended the call.

Sneha stood by the window, still holding her phone close to her heart.

For the first time in days, the unanswered questions no longer felt so heavy.

Without even realizing it, Siddu had found a special place in her heart.

She wasn't ready to call it love.

Not yet.

But every thought of him brought an uncontrollable smile to her face as she quietly looked forward to the weekend that would reunite them once again.

The next morning, Sneha woke up with a smile she couldn't hide.

It was her first day at work.

After getting ready, she made her way to the office, excitement and nervousness walking beside her.

Once she completed the formalities, she headed straight to her team leader's cabin.

She gently knocked on the door.

"May I come in, ma'am?"

"Come in," a familiar voice replied.

Sneha stepped inside with a smile.

"Good morning, ma'am. I'm Sneha Deepika."

Rohini looked up from her laptop and immediately recognized her.

"Sneha... you're the one who called me yesterday, aren't you?"

"Yes, ma'am," Sneha replied politely.

Rohini smiled.

"Welcome to the team. Please have a seat."

Sneha thanked her and sat down.

For a moment, there was silence before Rohini leaned back in her chair and looked at Sneha with a curious smile.

"Can I ask you something?"

"Of course, ma'am."

"What is it about Siddharth's story that has made you so determined to find him?"

Sneha thought for a moment before answering honestly.

"I really don't know, ma'am. Maybe it's because he never got the chance to finish his story. Ever since he left the train, I've been unable to stop thinking about what happened to him."

Rohini observed her quietly.

A playful smile slowly appeared on her face.

"Sneha..."

"Yes, ma'am?"

"I hope you realize that people don't usually search this hard for someone they met just once."

Sneha blinked in confusion.

"W-What do you mean, ma'am?"

Rohini couldn't help but smile.

"Sneha... I think you've started liking Siddharth."

Sneha's eyes widened.

"No, ma'am!" she replied immediately. "It's nothing like that."

"Really?" Rohini asked, raising an eyebrow.

Sneha nodded repeatedly.

"I'm just curious about his story. That's all."

Rohini smiled knowingly.

"If you say so."

Sneha looked away, slightly embarrassed, unsure why her heart had started beating faster.

Perhaps Rohini was simply teasing her...

Or perhaps...

She quickly pushed the thought aside.

Rohini closed the file on her desk and stood up.

"Alright," she said. "Enough talking about Siddharth."

She smiled warmly.

"We have plenty of work waiting for us. Come on, let me introduce you to the team."

Sneha nodded and followed her.

Rohini introduced Sneha to the rest of the team. Everyone welcomed her warmly, making her nervousness slowly disappear. She spent the day understanding the project, setting up her workstation, learning the workflow from her teammates, and gradually settling into her new workplace.

The days slipped by faster than Sneha had expected.

And with every passing day...

The weekend—and her long-awaited meeting with Siddu—came one step closer.
